Leathery_Bat_Like_Canine_Wings.description: Emerging from the twisted lineage of arcane experiments, these leathery bat-like canine wings are a grotesque yet functional appendage, granting their bearer the grace and agility of a predator in the air, along with an innate talent for aerobatic maneuvers that weave through the skies with eerie precision.

Feathered_Avian_Like_Canine_Wings.description: Emerging from the creature’s shoulder blades, these bizarre wings are a fusion of avian feathering and canine fur, their membranous structure enabling swift and silent flight while also granting unparalleled speed and agility in both air and land.

Cybernetic_Jet_Pack_Wings.description: Emerging from the twisted fusion of flesh and circuitry, the Cybernetic Jet Pack Wings sprout from the mutant canine's back, metallic feathers interwoven with sleek, aerodynamic plates that pulse with neon blue energy, granting the creature unparalleled speed and the ability to soar through the night sky with otherworldly grace.

Skeletal_Undead_Bone_Wings.description: These bone-chilling wings are the twisted mutation of an ancient canine, now undead, with jagged edges and a haunting aura that strikes fear into the hearts of the living, while granting the bearer the ability to soar through the night skies.

Insectoid_Gossamer_Canine_Wings.description: Emerging from the mutated form of a once-proud canine, these insectoid gossamer wings are a fragile yet marvelously agile appendage, granting the creature the ability to soar through the skies with acrobatic grace, though they come at the cost of the creature's natural protective barrier.

Symbiotic_Spore_Dispersal_Wings.description: Emerging from the corrupted flesh of a canine mutant, these fungal wings pulse with a sickly green light, their membranous surfaces dotted with spores that disperse a choking cloud of poison as they flap, granting both the deadly ability to poison foes and a natural resistance to the toxins themselves.

Armored_Plated_Canine_Wings.description: Emerging from the twisted flesh of this mutant canine are thick, plated wings, a grotesque amalgamation of bone and chitinous armor, granting both aerial mobility and formidable defensive capabilities, though at the cost of ground speed and agility.

Bioluminescent_Display_Canine_Wings.description: Emerging from the genetic aberrations of a dark sorcerer's experiments, the Bioluminescent Display Canine Wings are a marvel of unnatural mutation, granting their bearer the ability to soar through the night sky with the grace of a predator, their wings casting an eerie, phosphorescent glow that can both mesmerize and reveal their presence to friend and foe alike.

Vestigial_Non_Functional_Wings.description: Emerging from the creature's spine are a pair of large, feathered wings, atrophied and incapable of flight, their presence a haunting reminder of a past evolutionary path, now rendered merely decorative and a source of subtle charm.

Translucent_Ghostly_Canine_Wings.description: Emerging from the spectral essence of a long-deceased canine, these translucent wings pulse with a faint, otherworldly glow, granting their bearer ethereal sight and a ghostly agility that cuts through the air with silent grace.
